items.title: U.S. Congressional Budget Office hit by suspected foreign cyberattack
items.description: The U.S. Congressional Budget Office (CBO) confirms it suffered a cybersecurity incident after a suspected foreign hacker breached its network, potentially exposing sensitive data. [...]

items.title: ZDI-CAN-28529: llama.cpp
items.description: A CVSS score 4.0 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N severity vulnerability discovered by 'Nitesh Surana (niteshsurana.com) of Trend Research' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-11-06, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-03-06 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
